runners_data.name: Dramatic License

runners_data.note: Only confirmed leader with proven ability to win from the front, especially effective when uncontested

runners_data.name: Jehol De Thaix
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with decent soft ground record but needs strong pace to be effective

runners_data.name: Nosy Neighbour

races.paceDynamic: Snowrocco is the only genuine front-runner and will likely get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable pace that suits his winning style. With most rivals adopting prominent or hold-up tactics, the race will develop into a tactical affair where the pace-setters like Chemoulin, Milan Park and Dramatic License can stalk Snowrocco before the closers unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Snowrocco gets an easy lead and maintains stamina over 2m6f
scenarios.body: The front-runner controls the tempo and has enough left to resist late challenges. His two recent wins from the front at this trip prove his effectiveness when untroubled.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes steady and prominent runners can conserve energy
scenarios.body: Chemoulin or Milan Park can sit close enough to Snowrocco to strike in the straight. The winner comes from those tracking the leader rather than the hold-up horses behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Finishing Kick
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely run and the race sets up for closers
scenarios.body: Tamarind Bay's class advantage (OR 115) tells as the front-runners weaken. The highest-rated horse benefits from a truly-run race that exposes the stamina limitations of the pace-setters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Snowrocco fails to lead or the pace becomes messy early
scenarios.body: Without the expected front-runner, the race becomes muddled and tactical. An unconsidered runner like Tea Boy or Nosy Neighbour can benefit from the chaos and lack of pace.

watchPoints.text: Snowrocco failing to take up the running early would create pace chaos and completely change race dynamics
Tamarind Bay getting a prominent position early rather than his usual hold-up role could signal tactical switch
Chemoulin's jumping under pressure in the straight as he's been consistent but not always fluent over hurdles
The pace after the first mile - if genuinely strong it favors the closers, if steady it suits the prominent runners
Milan Park's stamina reserves at 2m6f as his best efforts have come over shorter distances

races.paceDynamic: R Krista stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will dictate a moderate gallop with Valette, I C U In My Dreams and Royal Maggs settling prominent but not pressuring early. The large hold-up contingent of Lady Lucky, Lipstick Traces, Dame In Disguise and Curious Mrs Fox creates a dangerous kick scenario if the pace stays sedate, while unknown quantity Cappa Lass adds tactical uncertainty.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sedate Pace Kick
scenarios.trigger: If R Krista gets an uncontested lead and the prominent horses settle too kindly
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get perfect conditions to unleash their finishing kicks in the straight. Lady Lucky and Lipstick Traces benefit most from the patient ride scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Wars
scenarios.trigger: If Valette and I C U In My Dreams put genuine pressure on R Krista throughout
scenarios.body: The pace becomes testing enough to set up a war of attrition where stamina and class tell. The prominent racers who can handle the gallop have first run on the closers.
winners: I C U In My Dreams

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If R Krista gets clear daylight and none of the prominent horses track closely enough
scenarios.body: The leader gets too good a start and maintains enough advantage to resist late challenges. The soft ground aids stamina but R Krista's uncontested position proves decisive.
others: I C U In My Dreams

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unknown Disruption
scenarios.trigger: If Cappa Lass shows unexpected pace or tactical awareness to change the complexion
scenarios.body: The lightly raced runner either goes with R Krista to force pace or tracks perfectly to benefit from any setup. Her unknown ability and tactics create the surprise element.
winners: I C U In My Dreams

watchPoints.text: Royal Maggs tracking too close to R Krista early as her fading tendency makes her a pace liability
I C U In My Dreams getting outpaced if the kick comes too suddenly given her need to be handy
Lady Lucky getting too far back if R Krista goes clear as she needs others to pressure the leader
Cappa Lass showing any early pace intentions that could disrupt the expected tactical setup
Curious Mrs Fox staying on late despite her fading pattern as distance increase might help stamina

races.paceDynamic: Cahier's Den will likely lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners in this field of predominantly hold-up horses. This creates a tactical race where the pace-setter can dictate terms, potentially being joined by one of the prominent racers like Sir Carnegie or Florita if they break well. The lack of early pace pressure should result in a moderate gallop that will favor those who can quicken late over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Cahier's Den Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Cahier's Den gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady gallop
scenarios.body: The pace-setter dictates the race from the front, kicking clear at the business end when the hold-up horses are still organizing their challenges. None of the staying-on horses can peg back the leader's advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and bunches the field for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows multiple hold-up horses to get into contention, creating a cavalry charge from the back. Superior class and finishing speed determine the outcome in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Soft Ground Specialist
scenarios.trigger: If the soft going significantly favors those with proven soft ground form
scenarios.body: Horses with strong recent soft ground form come to the fore as others struggle with the conditions. Form horses with demonstrated soft ground ability prove superior to those less suited to the going.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Cahier's Den goes too fast early or fades dramatically, creating a scramble
scenarios.body: The lack of natural pace-setters creates chaos when the designated leader fails to fulfill the role. An unfancied hold-up horse benefits from the tactical mess to spring a surprise.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Cahier's Den gets pressured early for the lead as this could set up a completely different race dynamic
Monitor how quickly Sir Carnegie and Rosa Diaz travel through the race given their hold-up styles in a slowly-run contest
Observe Florita's jumping rhythm as recent soft ground winner with strong staying credentials over this trip
Check if any of the hold-up horses get squeezed for room in what could become a bunched finish
Watch for Aill Dubh improving from the back if the pace becomes truly moderate

races.paceDynamic: Fingal's Hill will likely dictate from the front with his natural pace advantage, but the cluster of prominent runners (Lawrenny, Great Pepper, Rare Edition, Haarar) should keep him honest without creating excessive pressure. The hold-up pair Bold Light and Smokeringinthedark will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their finishing kicks over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Fingal's Hill gets an easy lead with the prominent runners settling kindly
scenarios.body: Fingal's Hill controls the tempo and has enough left to resist challenges, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the soft surface. The prominent runners get first run but can't quite peg back the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Pressure Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Great Pepper, Lawrenny and Haarar all press Fingal's Hill early and create a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable and the front group comes back to the hold-up horses in the final furlong. Bold Light and Smokeringinthedark benefit most from the strong pace scenario over this staying distance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners bide their time and produce a sustained finish from the 3f pole
scenarios.body: Lawrenny, Great Pepper and Haarar engage in a tactical battle while Fingal's Hill weakens and the hold-up pair don't get enough pace to work with. The best stayer among the prominent group prevails.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Bold Light Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong throughout and sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses
scenarios.body: Bold Light gets the ideal strong pace scenario and produces his trademark late surge to collar the prominent runners. Smokeringinthedark also benefits but Bold Light's superior class tells in the closing stages.

watchPoints.text: Fingal's Hill could get an uncontested lead if the prominent runners are too patient early on.
Bold Light and Smokeringinthedark both need a strong pace to be effective so watch for early positioning.
Great Pepper and Lawrenny may clash for the same prominent pitch behind the leader.
Haarar's recent winning form and tactical versatility makes him dangerous in multiple scenarios.
The soft ground strongly favors horses with proven form on the surface, eliminating little-exposed types.

races.paceDynamic: Ceolwulf appears the most likely sole leader with several prominent racers (Ozzy Cosmo, Kingston Rock, Zumbi, Play By The Rules, Euchan Falls) likely to track closely behind, creating a reasonable gallop without being frantic. The substantial hold-up contingent including El Muchacho, Passengerontheship, Cave Hill, Sputnik and Didntgotwenty will depend on the pace being strong enough over this staying trip on testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners maintain steady pressure on Ceolwulf throughout
scenarios.body: The pace becomes testing enough to stretch the field but not collapse the leaders. Hold-up horses find themselves with too much to do on the soft ground over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Favors Closers
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners (Ozzy Cosmo, Zumbi, Kingston Rock) press Ceolwulf aggressively
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable and the leaders weaken significantly in the straight. The class hold-up horses with proven soft ground form get their ideal scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Tempo Tactical Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group settles too kindly behind Ceolwulf without genuine pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where positioning and jumping matter most. Horses with tactical speed from prominent positions or those who can quicken hold the advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Errors Change Dynamic
scenarios.trigger: If key fancied runners make significant jumping mistakes at crucial stages
scenarios.body: The race shape becomes disrupted with new leaders emerging or pace collapse occurring. Reliable jumpers who stay out of trouble benefit regardless of their ideal running style.

watchPoints.text: Ceolwulf's jumping under pressure as he's shown tendency to make mistakes when challenged
Early pace battle between prominent runners Ozzy Cosmo, Zumbi and Kingston Rock could set things up for closers
Passengerontheship's ability to get competitive position as he needs to be closer on this testing ground
El Muchacho's enthusiasm early on as his recent runs suggest confidence issues
Jumping accuracy throughout the field as the soft ground will make recovery from errors more difficult

races.paceDynamic: Rock N Roll Champ will lead with Lone Star and Glory Hights likely to press him early, creating a reasonable but not overly strong gallop over this extended trip. With seven hold-up horses in the field, the pace will be sustainable through the middle stages before intensifying from three out as the large pack of closers converge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Rock N Roll Champ maintains a solid tempo and the prominent runners stay involved
scenarios.body: The leaders get first run and hold off the late charge as the soft ground blunts the finishing kick of the hold-up horses. Lone Star's class and Glory Hights' soft ground form prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian and the field bunches turning for home
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get ideal conditions to unleash their finishing kicks with Tyson and Slack Alice having the strongest turns of foot. The leaders fold as the closers swamp them in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Grinding Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground really takes its toll and creates an attritional battle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of stamina rather than speed with horses grinding out the finish. Fairly Fulling's recent win and Joto's consistent soft ground placings see them emerge from the pack.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If Rock N Roll Champ gets an uncontested lead and the field fails to close
scenarios.body: The leader gets away with murder on the front end and builds an unassailable advantage. Despite his modest rating, he holds on as the field leaves their run too late on the testing ground.

watchPoints.text: Rock N Roll Champ could steal this if he gets an uncontested lead and the field is slow to react.
Glory Hights has strong soft ground credentials but needs to overcome a moderate recent run.
Tyson requires a strong pace to be effective and could struggle if the gallop is modest.
Fairly Fulling's recent form upturn makes her dangerous despite the rise in grade.
The large group of hold-up horses could compromise each other if they all wait too long.

races.paceDynamic: Roarin' Success is the only confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead, with the prominent brigade of Book Of Secrets, Lady Babs, Nottodaybobo and Glenridding settling just behind. With 9 hold-up horses in the field, this creates a perfect scenario for sustained galloping pace that will test stamina over the extended 2m1f trip on testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Roarin' Success gets soft fractions and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The pace stays manageable through the first mile allowing the leader to kick clear turning for home. The hold-up brigade struggle to make up ground on the testing surface.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses apply pressure to Roarin' Success from halfway
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more honest which starts to tell on the leader in the final half-mile. One of the prominent trackers has enough left to kick clear of the struggling pack.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes stop-start
scenarios.body: The soft ground and steady gallop sets up perfectly for the closers who get cover and can unleash late runs. The early leaders pay for their prominence in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Grind
scenarios.trigger: If genuine pace develops and the race becomes a true staying test
scenarios.body: The extended trip and soft ground finds out several runners as only the most genuine stayers can cope. Form horses with stamina doubts fold completely.

watchPoints.text: Roarin' Success getting too soft a lead early - if uncontested he could steal this
Lady Babs and Nottodaybobo both tracking prominently - their soft ground records differ significantly
Newport sitting quietly in rear - has the class and staying power to be dangerous late
Multiple hold-up horses with finishing problems - Littletown Lad, Blazing Echo, Defying Gravity could cause traffic issues
Travis Wheatley held up early - needs cover and a clear run to show his best
